SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, u.contact, o.product_id AS productId, o.product_name AS productName, CAST(o.amount / 100.0 AS DECIMAL(10, 2)) AS amount, o.status, o.paid_at AS paidAt, o.created_at AS createdAt FROM orders o LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = o.user_id ORDER BY o.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, product_id, product_name, amount, status, pay_type) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{payType})
